input: Can I cancel my order if it has already been shipped?
expected_output: No, orders in SHIPPED or OUT_FOR_DELIVERY status cannot be cancelled once handed over to the carrier. You can either refuse delivery at your door or accept the parcel and initiate a standard return within the 30-day return window.
context: Cancellation is strictly impossible once the package has been handed over to the carrier (FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL). In this scenario: 1. Allow the package to be delivered. 2. Refuse delivery at the door or accept the parcel and initiate a standard return within our 30-day return window.

input: What is the return window and what conditions must items meet to get a full refund?
expected_output: The return window is 30 days from the confirmed delivery date. To qualify for a full refund, items must be in original, unused condition with all tags attached, in original packaging with accessories and manuals. Footwear and apparel must be unworn, and electronics must be restored to factory settings.
context: Customers may request a return within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date. Returns initiated after 30 days cannot be accepted.

To qualify for a full refund: Items must be in their original, unused condition with all tags attached. All original manufacturer packaging, user manuals, accessories, and documentation must be included. Footwear and apparel must be unworn and unwashed. Electronics must have personal data cleared and factory settings restored.

input: Who pays for return shipping if I received a damaged or defective item?
expected_output: If the return is due to store error (such as a defective, damaged, or incorrect item), the store provides a prepaid return shipping label at no cost to the customer.
context: If the return is due to our error (defective, damaged, or incorrect item), we provide a prepaid return shipping label.
For buyer's remorse or preference changes, the customer is responsible for the return shipping cost ($6.99 flat-rate label deducted from refund).

input: How long does it take for a refund to show up on my credit card after an item is returned?
expected_output: Once the returned parcel is received at the warehouse, inspection takes up to 2 business days. Once approved, the refund is issued to your original payment method and typically appears on your credit card statement within 3 to 5 business days.
context: Once our warehouse receives the returned package, inspection is completed within 2 business days.
Credit Card and Debit Card refunds typically appear on your billing statement within 3 to 5 business days depending on your financial institution.

input: Are gift cards and opened personal grooming items returnable?
expected_output: No, activated gift cards, downloadable software, perishable goods, and personal grooming or intimate apparel items with opened packaging are strictly non-returnable for safety, hygiene, and copyright reasons.
context: The following categories are strictly non-returnable for safety, hygiene, and copyright reasons: Perishable goods, Downloadable software products, digital licenses, and activated gift cards, Intimate apparel, swimwear, and personal health/grooming items if packaging is opened, Custom-engraved or personalized merchandise.
